suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment associated risk. Require type 2 diabetes plus documented GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure preceding GERD/GERD complications; model as a treatment-associated pathway, not diabetes itself. Active-comparator cohort evidence concerns GLP-1 RA treatment; do not generalize to untreated T2DM. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment or procedure used for Diabetes Mellitus Type 2
Independent diagnosis of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and source-phenotype fit
